description:
Bigme HiBreak Pro app to unlock the phone with your face.
This app frequently connected to lp.xl-ads.com in the past, which caused security concerns on Reddit in relation to the BadBox 2.0 botnet and Bigme to issue a firmware upgrade that changes the usage of that domain.
If disabled, face unlock won't work and the option to activate it in the settings will crash Bigme's settings app.
